newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end lower after strong week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end lower after strong week.

text.p: July 18 - U.S. debt futures ended sharply lower, never recovering from an early profit-taking pullback. Some traders elected to liquidate long positions following Sept bonds' fresh seven-month high Thursday. Anticipation of Fed Chairman Greenspan's Humphrey-Hawkins testimony next week, Dow plunge, Aug options expiry all contributed pressure, traders said.
